notes: One entry per drug x patient, and for sufentanil and remimazolam per adjustToFFM (TRUE and FALSE).  `pk` is the complete default PK set from getDrugPK(drug, weight, height, age, sex, getDrugDefaults(drug), adjustToFFM)$PK$default: v1..cl3 come from the drug function (R/drugs_propofol.R, R/drugs_remifentanil.R, R/drugs_sufentanil.R, R/drugs_remimazolam.R); `drugFunction.size` is pkSizeFactors() for the two drugs that scale with it (R/pkSizeFactors.R); k10 = cl1/v1, k12 = cl2/v1, k13 = cl3/v1, k21 = cl2/v2, k31 = cl3/v3; lambda_1 >= lambda_2 >= lambda_3 are the roots of cube(k10, k12, k13, k21, k31) (R/cube.R, trigonometric solution of the cubic); p_coef_bolus_l1 = (k21 - l1)(k31 - l1) / ((l1 - l2)(l1 - l3) v1) and cyclic; p_coef_infusion_li = p_coef_bolus_li / li; ke0 is solved from tPeak, or for remimazolam supplied by the drug function and tPeak solved from it (see ke0-solve.json); ke0 is then separateEigenvalues(ke0, lambdas); e_coef_bolus_li = p_coef_bolus_li * ke0 / (ke0 - li), e_coef_bolus_ke0 = -(sum of the three), e_coef_infusion_li = e_coef_bolus_li / li, e_coef_infusion_ke0 = e_coef_bolus_ke0 / ke0. All ka_*, bioavailability_*, tlag_* and *_PO/IM/IN/SL/RA/PO2 coefficients are 0 for these IV drugs. `model` is tciApiModel()'s block verbatim; `model.hash` is md5 of jsonlite::toJSON(parameters rounded to signif(., 10), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = NA) followed by a newline (writeLines), i.e. tools::md5sum of that file. `branch`: remifentanil uses Kim 2017 at a BMI of 30 or more from REMIFENTANIL_KIM_MIN_AGE, unless Kim's model gives a non-positive parameter for the patient, and Eleveld 2017 otherwise; propofol is Eleveld 2018, sufentanil Gepts 1995, remimazolam Eleveld 2025.  adjustToFFM is accepted and ignored by propofol and remifentanil (each carries its own fat-free-mass covariate); sufentanil and remimazolam scale with pkSizeFactors() (volumes by the fat-free mass over the reference man's, clearances by that ratio ^ 0.75) and with adjustToFFM = FALSE use their legacy factors.
